why: I checked the evidence for all four PASS lines. Each one says only "This line looks fine and is clear." None of them names a wrong build that was tried or explains why the line would catch it, so the criterion fails for every PASS. Real gaps were also missed. The request asks to "keep the README's list of functions complete", but the README already leaves out slugify, which index.js exports. A build that adds only a padLeft section would meet "README.md has a section for padLeft" and still miss that part of the request. The output's "None found; the issue looks complete." skips this. The evidence also never cites any real files or behaviour, such as the existing tests in test/strutil.test.js, to back its PASS calls.
